text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—She did it! Satono Diamond has
conquered the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She broke the jinx that had long plagued Japanese Umamusume
and showcased her strength to the entire world!!!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hooooly shiiiiit!!!
Did she seriously win?!
I mean, it's the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan B
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it...! But they told me it was impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The 'world' is no longer just a dream!
Next year... and the year after that...
And even beyond, surely once again—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I really won...!
In a race they called impossible, I...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it, there's no such thing
as an outcome set in stone from the start...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Because everyone in Project L'Arc and my Trainer believed in that—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I saw it through to the end!
I'm sure the message reached everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter how desperately they wish for it,
it remains difficult for Japanese Umamusume to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is an unreachable height. Winning it is nothing more than a pipe dream."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Crushing such pointless folklore is precisely what gets the blood pumping—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The more people scream that it's impossible, the deeper the surprise and emotion when you achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The true thrill lies beyond overcoming hardships.
It is because I believe this that
I continue to reach forward.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It's a dream precisely because it can't come true"—as if!
Jinxes like that
exist solely to be broken!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dream of fully conquering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
once deemed "impossible"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Satono Diamond's magnificent feat was achieved—!
